command.name: joke
command.logic: echo Why did the programmer quit? Too many bugs!

command.name: system-info
command.logic: python -c "import json, platform; print(json.dumps({'os': platform.system(), 'release': platform.release(), 'architecture': platform.machine(), 'python': platform.python_version()}, indent=2))"

command.name: disk-usage
command.logic: python -c "import shutil; u = shutil.disk_usage('.'); print('Total: {:.2f} GiB | Used: {:.2f} GiB | Free: {:.2f} GiB'.format(u.total / 2**30, u.used / 2**30, u.free / 2**30))"

command.name: find-python
command.logic: python -c "from pathlib import Path; print('\n'.join(sorted(str(p) for p in Path('.').rglob('*.py') if p.is_file())) or 'No Python files found')"

command.name: hash-readme
command.logic: python -c "import hashlib; from pathlib import Path; print(hashlib.sha256(Path('README.md').read_bytes()).hexdigest())"

command.name: file-report
command.logic: python -c "import json; from pathlib import Path; print(json.dumps([{'name': p.name, 'bytes': p.stat().st_size} for p in sorted(Path('.').iterdir()) if p.is_file()], indent=2))"
